# Principle

Lessons learnt from cyber security incidents are captured, and areas for improvement are identified, prioritised and actioned in a timely manner.

# Indicators of Good Practice

Not effective:
- Detection rules, monitoring coverage and response procedures are not reviewed following incidents.

Partially effective:
- Reviews are conducted but do not result in documented changes to detection or response capabilities.
- Some improvements are made but not systematically tracked or validated.

Fully effective:
- Detection rules, monitoring coverage and cyber security incident response procedures are reviewed following incidents, with identified lessons incorporated into updates.
- Changes are documented, tested and validated for effectiveness.
title: Evaluate the monitoring coverage and cyber security incident response procedures following cyber security incidents.
